One quote, three receipts
A treasury volunteer sees a stablecoin quote fall to zero point nine nine three. Should anyone be paged? These three testnet receipts follow one signed quote through Reactive to Base.
一笔模拟报价跌至 0.9930，是否通知财库？三笔测试网回执追踪同一源事件。
The threshold
The first test quote moved ten basis points and stayed inside the band. The second moved seventy. Reactive checks the publisher, the event and its identity before it requests the callback.
对照报价偏离 10 个基点。触发报价偏离 70 个基点。Reactive 核对发布者、事件和身份后发起回调。
One event identity
Open the Base receipt. Its source hash and log index point back to the Sepolia quote. Lasna routed that same event. The three block timestamps span two seconds in this one example.
打开 Base 回执，源交易哈希和日志序号指向同一条 Sepolia 报价。此次三链区块时间戳相差两秒。
What the team knew at signing
At signing the reviewers had a genuine callback and a simulated price, but no independent market packet. The model kept the alert and withheld its score. That original record is still available.
签名时，回调真实上链，报价由测试合约模拟。缺少独立行情，模型保留告警并暂缓评分。
A market replay at the same instant

We then retrieved exchange records that had closed before the event. Bitstamp priced U S D C at about one dollar. Coinbase priced Tether slightly below one dollar. Both candles closed twelve seconds before the quote.
回溯当时已收盘的行情。Bitstamp 提供 USDC 美元价，Coinbase 提供 USDT 美元价，两者均早于事件 12 秒收盘。
The model makes a decision

Select archived exchange prices. The same frozen neural network now says continue observing. None of fifteen earlier Binance closes confirmed the simulated fall. The alert stays on Base, and the treasury retains the decision.
切换到交易所历史行情，同一模型建议继续观察。币安此前 15 个收盘价均未印证该跌幅。
Would a simpler rule work?

We compared three policies on two hundred and eight historical crossings with complete follow-up. Referring every crossing produced fourteen short-lived referrals. The written policy produced twelve. The model produced ten.
在后续行情完整的 208 次历史越界中，全部升级产生 14 次短暂偏离转介，书面规则 12 次，模型 10 次。
The cost of quieter alerts

The model and the written rule each held back three persistent crossings and abstained on one more. Our outcome measures five minutes of price persistence. These are overlapping market observations, not independent treasury incidents.
模型和书面规则均对 3 次持续越界建议观察，对另 1 次暂缓判断。指标衡量五分钟价格持续性，样本时段重叠。
